Print the pod's recent agent, llama-server and cloudflared logs

Usage:
  lobo logs [flags]

Flags:
  -h, --help    help for logs
  -n, --n int   number of lines (max 1000) (default 200)

Global Flags:
      --config string   config file (dotenv; the OS env is never read) (default "/home/u/.config/lobo/config.env")
